sources.title: 搶攻電動車 鴻華先進：2月接單4月出貨
sources.locator: Article passage on Foxtron’s relationship with MIH; quotes Foxtron General Manager Lee Ping-yen.
sources.note: Directly reports the executive’s statement that Foxtron was one of MIH Alliance’s founding members.

sources.title: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. Q3 FY20 Results
sources.effective_period: Prospective statement concerning MIH’s planned independence by June 2021
sources.locator: Slide titled “What is MIH Alliance?”, PDF page 21/31.
sources.note: States Hon Hai and Foxtron would be MIH founder members after the organization became independent; corroborates the plan, not by itself the later completion.

sources.title: 鴻華先進科技自主開發電動巴士MODEL T 正式交付高雄客運
sources.effective_period: Model T electric bus delivered March 3, 2022
sources.locator: Chairman Liu Young-way’s remarks on Model T components.
sources.note: States that over 65% of Model T components were supplied by MIH Alliance members and Taiwanese suppliers; the combined groups are not disaggregated, and this is not a measure of MIH membership composition.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Seven focused search turns found evidence for the historical founding-member relationship and a related but non-equivalent Model T sourcing figure. The Taiwan-supplier percentage remains unresolved because its scope, period, and denominator are unspecified.
MIH membership evidence supports Foxtron’s historical founding-member status; it does not verify its current membership status.
The Model T percentage is a combined sourcing figure for MIH Alliance members and Taiwanese suppliers, not a standalone Taiwan-supplier percentage.
No reliable source found that defines the denominator, measurement basis, or period for the claimed Taiwan-supplier share.
